main.js: Panel UI (CEP page). Takes: skill.json files, button presses, the test hook /tmp/peny-toolkit/inbox/run.json. Gives: the home screen, app views, progress bars, History, the log. Touches: ~/Library/Logs/PenyToolkit.log, /tmp/peny-toolkit (hook, result files), ~/.peny-toolkit settings, Premiere through evalScript (one call at a time), every skill's panel.js.
loader.js: Loads main.js and soft-reloads it in place. Touches: /tmp/peny-toolkit/instance, loader-alive (heartbeat every second), reload-stamp, reloaded.json; PenyToolkit.log.
core/core.jsx: ExtendScript helpers shared by every skill (PenyToolkit.*). Takes: Premiere's app/project/sequence objects. Gives: JSON strings back to the panel ({ok, summary|error, details}). Touches: the active project's sequences (copies only), ~/Library/Logs/PenyToolkit.log, /tmp/peny-toolkit/ame/<job>.json (Media Encoder callbacks).
core/jobs.js: Job pool for shell jobs (ffmpeg/REDline renders). Takes: jobs {key, cmd, outputPath, kind, weight}. Gives: summary, progress, ETA. Touches: child processes (exec, kill), output files (size, moov atom, ffprobe frame count), the ETA history JSON.
core/steps.js: Progress bar for multi-step skills. Takes: step ids, size. Gives: progress events like JobPool's. Touches: its history JSON.
core/camera.js: Camera model from the footage files. Takes: clips [{path}]. Gives: clip.camera. Touches: reads 6 MB of one file per folder, REDline --printMeta for R3D, a JSON cache.
core/shootdate.js: Shoot day of each clip. Takes: clips [{path}], ffprobe path. Gives: clip.shootDay/shootTime/dateFrom/size. Touches: reads R3D headers, Sony XML sidecars, ffprobe, a JSON cache.
core/ame.js: Waits for a Media Encoder render. Takes: job id, output path. Gives: {ok, path, ms} or {ok:false, error}. Touches: polls and deletes /tmp/peny-toolkit/ame/<job>.json.
core/updater.js: Runs update scripts from inside the panel. Takes: isBusy(). Touches: runs ~/Library/Application Support/PenyToolkit/update.sh every 5 min and the build Mac's auto-update.sh hourly.
skills/import-footage/walkLogic.js: What Ingest imports from a footage folder (RED .RDC, ARRIRAW, flat files, Audio folders, skipped Proxies/Exports). Takes: a listEntries function. Gives: items per bin path. Touches: nothing itself.
skills/import-footage/panel.js: Ingest, Node side. Takes: a footage folder. Gives: import results. Touches: walks the folder (fs), calls premiere.jsx to make bins and import.
skills/import-footage/premiere.jsx: Ingest, Premiere side: bins mirroring the folder tree, importFiles, checks of what is already imported. Touches: the project's bins and items (adds only).
skills/ingest-pipeline/panel.js: Ingest + Proxies: Import, then Proxies render and attach, with a job queue across projects. Touches: the other two skills' actions; saves a project only with Save each project on and after every step passed.
skills/ingest-pipeline/premiere.jsx: Which project is in front; saves one open project by path (Ingest + Proxies only).
skills/proxy-automation/panel.js: Proxies: plans and renders ProRes Proxy files (ffmpeg / REDline), then attaches or detaches them. Takes: bin, destination folder, speed. Touches: renders into the destination folder (never deletes), the job pool, ffprobe frame checks.
skills/proxy-automation/premiere.jsx: Proxies, Premiere side: lists clips with media and proxy state; attachProxy/detach. Touches: project items' proxy links.
skills/proxy-automation/red-proxy-finish: Turns a REDline render into the final RED proxy (full-range levels, mono streams in R3D order). Touches: writes <name>_Proxy.mov, removes the REDline part file on success only.
skills/link-external-audio/premiere.jsx: Links each camera clip to its own audio and the wav under it on a TOOLKIT COPY, in pieces. Touches: selection and links on the copy only.
skills/sync-external-audio/panel.js: Sync external audio, Node side: scan, measure.py, place. Touches: ffmpeg/REDline reads, a cache folder.
skills/sync-external-audio/premiere.jsx: Sync external audio, Premiere side: reads camera clips and wavs; places wav pieces on a TOOLKIT COPY.
skills/sync-external-audio/measure.py: GCC-PHAT waveform match of camera audio in recorder wavs. Takes: JSON job on stdin. Gives: JSON results on stdout. Touches: ffmpeg decodes only.
skills/interview-selects/panel.js: Interviews: transcribe (whisper), find answers (Ollama, local), cut & raise, trim, remove ums. Touches: renders the sequence audio, ~/PenyToolkit-scratch, starts Ollama if needed, the '<sequence> Cut' copy.
skills/interview-selects/pipeline.js: Transcript -> speaker labels -> answers -> notes. Takes: whisper JSON, a 16 kHz wav. Gives: answer spans with topics. Touches: Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434.
skills/interview-selects/fillers.js: Finds um/uh fillers with two whisper passes and the sound envelope. Touches: ffmpeg/whisper runs passed in, clip files in a work folder.
skills/interview-selects/premiere.jsx: Interviews, Premiere side: scan, '<sequence> Cut' copy, markers, razor + raise, trim, unum. Touches: only the Cut/No ums copies.
skills/interview-sync/panel.js: Sync Interviews, Node side: syncmeasure.py over every clip, then apply. Touches: ffmpeg reads, proxies.
skills/interview-sync/premiere.jsx: Sync Interviews, Premiere side: scan units; apply moves on its own copy; link.
skills/interview-sync/syncmeasure.py: Sync Interviews measuring (sound, then picture motion for silent cameras). JSON in/out. Touches: ffmpeg/ffprobe reads.
skills/sound-pass/panel.js: Sound Pass: renders, measures and keys voice levels on a TOOLKIT COPY.
skills/sound-pass/premiere.jsx: Sound Pass, Premiere side: scan, copy, limiter, keys, markers, render (TOOLKIT COPY only).
skills/sound-pass/measure.py: Sound Pass meter: blocks/stats/phrases/level/bed/check modes. JSON in/out. Touches: ffmpeg reads, .npz files it is given.
skills/loudness-master/panel.js: Master for YouTube: master copy, render, measure, limiter loop to -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP.
skills/loudness-master/premiere.jsx: Master for YouTube, Premiere side: prepare the MASTER TOOLKIT COPY, limiter, render, marker.
skills/loudness-master/measure.py: EBU R128 meter via ffmpeg ebur128. Takes: {wav, ffmpeg}. Gives: integrated, LRA, true/sample peak, duration.
skills/colour-baseline/panel.js: Colour: detect cameras, LUT picker, apply the baseline on a GRADED TOOLKIT COPY, make LUT presets. Touches: exports/imports a project XML copy, ~/.peny-toolkit LUT folders.
skills/colour-baseline/premiere.jsx: Colour, Premiere side: scan, export/import the graded copy, set Lumetri params (TOOLKIT COPY only).
skills/colour-baseline/lutpreset.py: Builds Lumetri-with-LUT effects and .prfpset preset files; grades a project XML copy.
skills/selects-sequences/panel.js: Selects Setup: scan footage bins, plan UNCUT + Selects sequences by shoot date and camera, build them.
skills/selects-sequences/premiere.jsx: Selects Setup, Premiere side: scan bins, make sequences and place clips (new sequences only).
skills/make-safe-copy/premiere.jsx: Make safe copy: '<name> TOOLKIT COPY' of the active sequence, opened; original checked unchanged.
install.sh: Developer Macs: rsync the checkout into CEP, ask the open panel to soft-reload. Prints OK / DEFERRED / ERROR / NO PANEL.
setup.sh: Developer Macs: Homebrew tools, models, Premiere settings, launchd agents, then install.sh. Safe to repeat.
auto-update.sh: Developer Macs, hourly: push, pull --ff-only, install.sh; build Mac also publishes.
installer/install-toolkit.sh: One-click installer: bundled tools + models into ~/Library/Application Support/PenyToolkit, panel into CEP. No admin, no Homebrew.
installer/update.sh: Installer Macs: reads version.json on the office server, copies and checks the zip, reinstalls.
tools/auto-commit-watcher.sh: Developer Macs: commits and pushes uncommitted changes on main after 3 quiet minutes.
tools/auto-publish.sh: Build Mac: publishes main to the office server.
tools/become-builder.sh: Makes this Mac the build machine.
tools/build-installer.sh: Build Mac: builds the one-click installer zip.
tools/publish-release.sh: Build Mac: copies a built installer to the office server and writes version.json.
tools/bundle_macho.py: Copies Homebrew programs with their dylibs into a relocatable folder (installer build).
tools/pool-limits-test.js: Self-check of the Full/Half speed limits in core/jobs.js.
